table.title: Note in a bullet list item

entry.codeblock: # Notification Methods The system supports the following notification methods: - Email Notifications > [!NOTE] > Email notifications require a configured SMTP server. - SMS Notifications - Webhook Notifications

Notification Methods

The system supports the following notification methods:

  • Email Notifications

    Email notifications require a configured SMTP server.

  • SMS Notifications

  • Webhook Notifications

section.p: Result: The converter preserves the relationship between the list item and the note. The note is generated within the corresponding DITA <li> element.
